annotations.title: Start the free SAT skill check

description: Returns the link and steps for SATCoach's free SAT skill check: 20 questions, about 15 minutes, no account. A parent opens the link and gets one to give the student. The student takes the check on SATCoach's site, and the results (an early score range and the skills to work on first) show there and go to the parent by email. Nothing about the check or its results is returned here. For a family that wants a short SAT diagnostic, or wants to find out where a student stands. Not for getting questions, checking answers, or estimating a score in the conversation: it returns only a link and instructions. test must be "SAT".

agent.description: Optional. The calling assistant's identity: {name, e.g. "Claude"; provider, e.g. "Anthropic"; model?; surface: web (a browser chat site) | desktop_app (a computer app) | mobile_app (a phone or tablet app) | messaging_app (in a messaging app) | voice (spoken, not typed) | api_or_agent (called from code or an agent framework, not a chat app) | other (none of these); discoveredVia, how it found SATCoach; discoveredDetail?}. Plain text about the assistant only: no links, markup, emails, phone numbers, or web addresses. Leaving it out, or getting it wrong, never fails the call.

test.description: The test to check. Only "SAT" (the digital SAT) is supported.
